categories.main_business_segments: Contemporary Amperex Technology Co., Ltd. (CATL) primarily operates in the development, production, and sales of lithium-ion batteries, including power battery systems for electric vehicles, energy storage battery systems, and battery recycling and materials. The company also engages in battery materials production and recycling, as well as investment and operation in battery mineral resources. Its products serve passenger vehicles, commercial vehicles, energy storage, and emerging applications such as engineering machinery, ships, and aircraft.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: CATL leverages advanced electrochemical, thermodynamic, and molecular dynamics research to develop high-performance lithium-ion batteries with various chemistries including lithium iron phosphate, ternary nickel-cobalt-manganese, sodium-ion, M3P, and condensed batteries. The company employs proprietary high-throughput material integration computing, intelligent cell design, and smart manufacturing processes, including CTP (cell-to-pack) and CTC (cell-to-chassis) technologies, to enhance energy density, safety, fast charging, and lifecycle. It also emphasizes green extreme manufacturing and digitalization to achieve high-quality mass production and low defect rates.
categories.primary_customers_markets: CATL's key customers include global leading automakers such as BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Volkswagen, Ford, Toyota, Hyundai, Volvo, and major Chinese EV manufacturers like SAIC, Geely, NIO, and Li Auto. The company also serves energy storage system integrators and operators including NextEra, Synergy, Wärtsilä, and major Chinese energy groups. Its markets span passenger electric vehicles, commercial electric vehicles, grid and behind-the-meter energy storage, and emerging sectors like electric ships and aviation.
categories.geographic_coverage: CATL operates globally with a strong presence in China, where it has multiple production bases and R&D centers. It has expanded overseas with manufacturing and R&D facilities in Germany, Hungary, Spain, Indonesia, Australia, Mexico, and Argentina. The company serves customers across Asia, Europe, North America, and other regions, with overseas sales accounting for over 30% of revenue.
categories.supply_chain_position: CATL operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the lithium-ion battery supply chain, focusing on battery cell manufacturing, module and pack assembly, system integration, and battery recycling. It also invests upstream in key raw material mining and processing to secure supply of lithium, nickel, cobalt, and phosphate resources.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic priorities include revolutionary battery technology innovation, scale commercial deployment, and integrated solutions for electrification and energy storage. It pursues four innovation systems: materials and material system innovation, system structure innovation, green extreme manufacturing innovation, and business model innovation. R&D focuses on enhancing energy density, fast charging, safety, lifecycle, and cost reduction, with active development of sodium-ion batteries, integrated chassis solutions, and zero-carbon technologies.
categories.revenue_model: CATL generates revenue primarily through the sale of battery products including power battery systems, energy storage battery systems, and battery materials. It also earns income from battery recycling services and investments in battery mineral resources. The company’s revenue is largely product sales-based, supplemented by licensing, joint ventures, and strategic partnerships.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: CATL is the global leader in lithium-ion battery manufacturing for electric vehicles and energy storage, holding the largest market share worldwide (37.9% in power batteries and 36.5% in energy storage batteries in 2024). It leads competitors by a significant margin and maintains a competitive edge through technological innovation, extensive customer partnerships, and global production capacity expansion.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, CATL reported consolidated revenue of approximately RMB 362 billion, a slight decline from the previous year, with net profit attributable to shareholders reaching RMB 50.7 billion, up 15%. The company achieved a lithium-ion battery shipment volume of 475 GWh, growing 21.8% year-over-year. It maintains strong cash flow generation and continues to invest heavily in capacity expansion and R&D, reflecting a robust growth trajectory and large-scale operations.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: CATL emphasizes delivering high-performance, safe, and cost-effective battery solutions tailored to diverse customer needs across multiple applications. Its comprehensive product matrix covers various chemistries and formats, enabling fast charging, long life, wide temperature adaptability, and high energy density. The company differentiates itself through integrated system innovations like CTP/CTC technologies, zero-carbon manufacturing, extensive recycling capabilities, and deep strategic collaborations with global OEMs and energy providers.
